authority_note: D01-D08 reflect the owner's conversation decisions. P01-P10 are recommended implementation defaults, revisable by the local agent with recorded reasons. No engine is implemented or verified by this handoff.

owner_decisions.decision: The owner is zfb's only current user; the new engines target the owner's consumers.
owner_decisions.consequence: Optimize for the owner's selected consumers and development workflow.
No universal class, directive, plugin, theme, or future-release parity requirement.

owner_decisions.decision: Build zudo-wind with an independently fixed specification.
owner_decisions.consequence: Version owned behavior and adopt upstream ideas on the owner's timing.

owner_decisions.decision: React and Preact compatibility may be dropped; hooks are not required.
owner_decisions.consequence: Migrate consumer semantics directly without mandatory emulation.

owner_decisions.decision: JSX/component authoring and true hydration are essential.
owner_decisions.consequence: Support server HTML and adoption of existing browser DOM.

owner_decisions.decision: Prefer a small built-in rendering model.
owner_decisions.consequence: Use a bounded API with explicit behavior and lifetimes.
No bundler replacement or custom JS/TS compiler in this work.

owner_decisions.decision: Continue implementation with a local AI agent.
owner_decisions.consequence: This deliverable is an implementation handoff, with no repository mutation or release.

recommended_defaults.default: Native Rust zudo-wind library in crates/zudo-wind.
Reuse the existing CSS/assets pipeline and Lightning CSS where suitable.
Tailwind v4.2.0 is an optional pinned reference for selected adopted cases, not the language authority.
Use a normalized source plan, explicit candidates/safelists, and deterministic contribution replacement/removal.
Original JSX runtime in packages/zudo-react with JSX, server, and client entry points.
Setup-once components; signal/computed objects are live JSX bindings; plain values and .value are snapshots.
Explicit scopes own bindings, activation callbacks, child scopes, and idempotent disposal.
Deterministic hydration boundaries and validation; no silent remount fallback.
Start with static composition, scalar bindings, native events, and forms; add structural regions when required by a real consumer.
Develop engines independently, prove a real CSS slice first, and integrate the JSX runtime after browser behavior is established.

non_goals: Publication or deployment from this handoff task
